discovery: A pack of wolves has a terrified child backed against a tree.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and see what's happening

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Stealth check to glimpse it unseen

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just keep walking

sneak_success: You circle wide through the undergrowth and startle the wolves from behind, scattering most of the pack before it notices the child.
sneak_fail: The wolves catch your scent on the wind and abandon the child to hunt easier prey - you.
ignore: You turn away. Somewhere behind you, the child's screams cut off into silence.

victim_data.dialogue: P-please... don't let them get me...
thanks: Y-you saved me... thank you, thank you!
after: The child clings close to you, still shaking.

aftermath.discovery: The wolves lie dead. The girl is still shaking, alone this far from anywhere safe.

choices.label: Escort Her to Town
choices.description: Walk her back to Northfield and the innkeeper's care
choices.outcome: You walk her the long way back to Northfield. The innkeeper takes her in without a word of complaint, and presses a few coins into your hand for the trouble.

choices.label: Point Her Toward Home
choices.description: She says she knows the way from here
choices.outcome: She wipes her eyes, nods, and takes off running down the trail on her own. You watch until she's out of sight.

choices.label: Leave Her Be
choices.description: ESC also cancels - she's not your problem
choices.outcome: You leave her sitting among the dead wolves and walk on. She doesn't call after you.
